Initial:3:1.text: Eighteen months of her being everything

Initial:3:2.text: Living in a flat that was hers

Initial:5:0.text: The best company at a lonely time

Initial:5:1.text: A dog leaning on his knee under the desk

Initial:5:2.text: Taken over before he saw it happen

Initial:9:0.text: Frost, an empty field and her loops

Initial:9:1.text: A moment that was theirs alone

Initial:11:0.text: Crossing the road for a dog not there

Initial:11:1.text: A body still keeping watch for her

Initial:13:0.text: Her head finding his foot again

Initial:13:1.text: The note through the door, the marked frame

Initial:13:2.text: Not leaving her at all, for months

Initial:15:0.text: Not feeling the loss while it happened

Initial:15:1.text: His sister seeing he never went out

Initial:17:0.text: A letter putting the tenancy in doubt

Initial:17:1.text: Unable to keep her or others safe

Initial:19:0.text: Choosing the flat, then choosing her

Initial:19:1.text: A life she could not do

Initial:19:2.text: Taking the fault as his own

Initial:21:0.text: Trying everything first, on the record

Initial:21:1.text: Exercises that never helped on the stairs

Initial:23:0.text: Awful and a relief at once

Initial:23:2.text: Feeling he was lying to her

Initial:25:0.text: Saying yes before hearing anything else

Initial:25:1.text: Her head in his lap, as if she knew

Initial:27:1.text: She did not look back again

Initial:31:1.text: Not crying when he thought he would

Initial:31:2.text: Keeping her bowl without knowing why

Initial:33:0.text: Still waking at quarter past five

Initial:33:1.text: Nothing to get up for, so lying there

Initial:35:0.text: Glad and something else with no name

groups.label: Living on her timetable, in the dark at both ends
groups.note: His days ran on her fear of other dogs, half five and eleven at night. The walks were also where he was happiest with her, and the hours have not left him.
groups.description: Half five and eleven at night, round her fear of other dogs, and the watching outlasts her

groups.label: Company in a lonely year, and a world closing in
groups.note: The best company he has had and the flat he could not leave are the same eighteen months. He did not feel the loss of everything else while it happened.
groups.description: The best company he had, in a flat he stopped leaving

groups.label: Unable to keep her, or anyone, safe in that flat
groups.note: The stairs, the letter and the fault he takes as his own. He keeps her blameless and wants it known that he tried.
groups.description: The letter, the stairs and the fault he takes as his own

groups.label: Giving her up and not settling what that was
groups.note: Relief and shame together, the drive to the farm, and three months of saying she is better off. It stays open, and he says so.
groups.description: Relief and shame together, and three months of saying she is better off

groups.label: Keeping her good name, and her bowl
groups.note: What he holds on to: her gentleness behind the shut door, the one sock, the bowl under the sink.
groups.description: Frightened, not a problem, and a bowl kept under the sink

groups.label: Still listening for other dogs
groups.note: The watchfulness he noticed only once she had gone.
groups.description: A body keeping watch for a dog no longer there

groups.label: Nobody asking any more
groups.description: A reason nobody argues with, and a sister who saw it first

groups.label: The day she went
groups.description: The yes, the drive, and arms with nothing to hold
